        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>end-fined</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>end-success</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="lane-owner" name="Car Owner">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>go-service-gw</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>pay-through-app</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="lane-mechanic" name="Mechanic">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>enter-problems</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>enter-success-pickerl</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>enter-next-service</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="start-event" name="Service necessary" />

    <bpmn:task id="check-registration" name="Check if car is still registered" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="registered-gw" name="Car still registered?" />
    <bpmn:task id="notify-owner" name="Notify owner" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="go-service-gw" name="Go to service?" />

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="timer-30-days" name="30 days">
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
        <bpmn:timeDuration>PT30D</bpmn:timeDuration>
      </bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="fine-owner" name="Fine owner" />

    <bpmn:task id="enter-problems" name="Enter problems of car" />
    <bpmn:task id="send-status-updates" name="Send status updates via email" />
    <bpmn:task id="pay-through-app" name="Pay through the app" />
    <bpmn:task id="enter-success-pickerl" name="Enter repair successful and Pickerl" />
    <bpmn:task id="enter-next-service" name="Enter time for next service" />

    <bpmn:endEvent id="end-not-registered" name="Car not registered" />
    <bpmn:endEvent id="end-fined" name="Owner fined" />
    <bpmn:endEvent id="end-success" name="Service completed" />

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f1" sourceRef="start-event" targetRef="check-registration" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f2" sourceRef="check-registration" targetRef="registered-gw" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f3" name="yes" sourceRef="registered-gw" targetRef="notify-owner" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f4" name="no" sourceRef="registered-gw" targetRef="end-not-registered" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f5" sourceRef="notify-owner" targetRef="go-service-gw" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f6" name="yes" sourceRef="go-service-gw" targetRef="enter-problems" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f7" name="no" sourceRef="go-service-gw" targetRef="timer-30-days" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f8" sourceRef="timer-30-days" targetRef="fine-owner" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f9" sourceRef="fine-owner" targetRef="end-fined" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f10" sourceRef="enter-problems" targetRef="send-status-updates" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f11" sourceRef="send-status-updates" targetRef="pay-through-app" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f12" sourceRef="pay-through-app" targetRef="enter-success-pickerl" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f13" sourceRef="enter-success-pickerl" targetRef="enter-next-service" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f14" sourceRef="enter-next-service" targetRef="end-success" />
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
